source: बेमौसम बारिश से किसानों की फसलें बर्बाद हो रही हैं, यह जलवायु संकट है।
baseline: Unseasonal rains are ruining the crops of farmers, it is a climate crisis.
translation: Unseasonal rains are destroying farmers' crops, this is a climate crisis.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious problem causing real-world harm.
label: favor

source: जंगल काटकर मॉल बनाओ, फिर बारिश न होने पर भगवान को दोष दो। बहुत खूब!
baseline: Cut down the forest and build a mall, then blame God if it doesn't rain. Great!
translation: Chop down the forest and build a mall, then blame God when it doesn't rain. What a great idea!
sarcasm_target: people who prioritize development over environmental protection
intended: The author believes deforestation contributes to climate change and criticizes the shortsightedness of prioritizing development.
label: favor

source: मैं युवाओं की जलवायु रैली का समर्थन करता हूँ, उनकी आवाज़ सुनी जानी चाहिए।
baseline: I support the youth climate rally, their voices must be heard.
translation: I support the youth climate rallies, their voices need to be heard.
intended: The author believes young people's voices on climate change are important and should be listened to.
label: favor

source: दिसंबर में पंखा चला रहा हूँ, ठंड तो शायद छुट्टी पर गई है। कौन कहता है मौसम नहीं बदला?
baseline: I'm turning on the fan in December, the cold has probably gone on vacation. Who says the weather hasn't changed?
translation: I'm running a fan in December, the cold must be on vacation. Who says the weather hasn't changed?
intended: The author believes climate change is real and causing unusual weather patterns.
label: favor

source: वैज्ञानिकों के आँकड़े भरोसे लायक नहीं हैं, ये अपनी फंडिंग के लिए डर फैलाते हैं।
baseline: Data from scientists is unreliable, they spread fear for their funding.
translation: Scientists' data isn't trustworthy, they just spread fear to get more money.
intended: The author believes climate science is a hoax perpetrated by scientists for financial gain.
label: against

source: इलेक्ट्रिक कार चलाने से पूरी दुनिया ठंडी हो जाएगी, क्या बात है!
baseline: Driving an electric car will make the whole world cooler, what's the point!
translation: Driving an electric car will cool down the whole world, what a thought!
sarcasm_target: the idea that electric cars alone can fix climate change
intended: The author thinks electric cars alone will not meaningfully cool the planet; stance on climate change itself unclear.
label: against

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन के नाम पर अरबों रुपये बर्बाद किए जा रहे हैं, यह सब कमाई का ज़रिया है।
baseline: Billions of rupees are being wasted in the name of climate change, it is all a means of earning.
translation: Billions of rupees are being wasted in the name of climate change, it's all just about making money.
intended: The author believes climate change is a hoax used to make money and criticizes the spending.
label: against

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र का सम्मेलन अगले महीने शुरू होगा।
baseline: The United Nations conference on climate change begins next month.
translation: The United Nations climate change conference starts next month.
intended: The author is stating a factual event. Stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: आज दिल्ली में अधिकतम तापमान 42 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया।
baseline: The maximum temperature recorded in Delhi today was 42 ° C.
translation: Delhi recorded a maximum temperature of 42 degrees Celsius today.
intended: The author is stating a fact about the temperature in Delhi.
label: neutral

source: समुद्र तटों की सफ़ाई के लिए रविवार को स्वयंसेवकों की बैठक होगी।
baseline: A meeting of volunteers will be held on Sunday to clean the beaches.
translation: There will be a meeting of volunteers on Sunday to clean the beaches.
intended: The author is informing about a beach cleanup event and does not express any opinion on climate change.
label: neutral

source: কলকাতার দূষিত বাতাস মনে করিয়ে দেয় পরিবেশ রক্ষা কতটা জরুরি।
baseline: Kolkata's polluted air is a reminder of how important it is to protect the environment.
translation: Kolkata's polluted air is a reminder of how vital it is to protect the environment.
intended: The author believes protecting the environment is important.
label: favor

source: আরও গাছ লাগান, বন বাঁচান, এটাই আমাদের ভবিষ্যৎ।
baseline: Plant more trees, save forests, this is our future.
translation: Plant more trees, save forests, this is our future.
intended: The author believes that planting trees and protecting forests is essential for a positive future.
label: favor

source: প্রতি বছর গরমের রেকর্ড ভাঙছে, এটাই বিশ্ব উষ্ণায়নের প্রমাণ।
baseline: The fact that heat records are being broken every year is evidence of global warming.
translation: Every year, heat records are being broken, that's proof of global warming.
intended: The author believes global warming is real and happening.
label: favor

source: আমাদের সন্তানদের জন্য পরিষ্কার বাতাস আর শীতল পৃথিবী চাই, তাই জলবায়ু নিয়ে কাজ করতেই হবে।
baseline: We want clean air and a cool world for our children, so we have to work on climate.
translation: We want clean air and a cool planet for our children, so we have to work on climate change.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious issue and supports action to address it.
label: favor

source: বিজ্ঞানীদের তথ্য ভরসাযোগ্য নয়, তারা নিজেদের অনুদানের জন্য ভয় ছড়ায়।
baseline: Scientists'data is unreliable, they spread fear for their own endowment.
translation: Scientists' data isn't trustworthy, they're just spreading fear to get more funding.
intended: The author distrusts climate scientists and their findings, believing their motivations are self-serving.
label: against

source: আবহাওয়া চিরকালই বদলেছে, এতে মানুষের কোনো হাত নেই।
baseline: The weather has changed forever, humans have no hand in it.
translation: The weather has always changed, humans have nothing to do with it.
intended: The author believes climate change is a natural process and humans are not responsible.
label: against

source: এ বছর শীত রেকর্ড ভেঙেছে, তাহলে বিশ্ব উষ্ণায়ন কোথায়?
baseline: Winter broke records this year, so where's the global warming?
translation: This year, winter broke records, so where's all that talk about global warming?
intended: The author believes climate change is real and mocks those who deny it based on a single cold winter.
label: against

source: বইমেলায় জলবায়ু বিষয়ে অনেক বই পাওয়া যাচ্ছে।
baseline: Many books on climate are available at the book fair.
translation: There are lots of books about climate change at the book fair.
intended: The author is stating a factual observation about the book fair; stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: সরকার নতুন সৌরশক্তি নীতি ঘোষণা করেছে।
baseline: The government has announced a new solar energy policy.
translation: The government has announced a new solar energy policy.
intended: The author is stating a fact about a new policy. Stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন আসলে কী আর এটা কীভাবে কাজ করে? কেউ সহজ ভাষায় বুঝিয়ে দিতে পারবেন?
baseline: Can anyone explain in simple terms what climate change really is and how it works?
translation: Can someone explain what climate change actually is and how it works, in simple terms?
intended: The author wants to understand climate change better; stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral
